intro: Corn, chillies and beans at its core, with a UNESCO-listed food culture far deeper than Tex-Mex: slow-cooked moles, street tacos and fresh salsas.
flavours: Corn (masa), chillies, lime, coriander, beans, avocado, tomatillo
hk: Hong Kong's taquerias and margarita bars have multiplied; most serve a mix of real Mexican and Tex-Mex.

dishes.name: Tacos al pastor
dishes.what: Pork marinated in chillies and achiote, roasted on a vertical spit and served in corn tortillas with pineapple.

dishes.name: Guacamole
dishes.what: Mashed avocado with lime, onion, chilli and coriander.

dishes.name: Enchiladas
dishes.what: Corn tortillas rolled around a filling and smothered in chilli sauce and cheese.

dishes.name: Mole poblano
dishes.what: Dark, complex sauce of chillies, spices and chocolate, poured over turkey or chicken.

dishes.name: Tamales
dishes.what: Corn dough with a filling, wrapped in a corn husk or banana leaf.

dishes.name: Pozole
dishes.what: Hearty soup of hominy corn and pork, topped with cabbage, radish and oregano.

dishes.name: Chiles en nogada
dishes.what: Stuffed poblano peppers under walnut cream and pomegranate, the colours of the Mexican flag.

dishes.name: Cochinita pibil
dishes.what: Yucatán pork slow-roasted in banana leaves with achiote and bitter orange.

dishes.name: Quesadilla
dishes.what: Tortilla folded over melted cheese (and in Mexico City, not always cheese!).

dishes.name: Elote
dishes.what: Grilled corn on the cob slathered with mayo, cotija cheese, chilli and lime.
